elementals-unbound-tempest.name: Elementals - Unbound Tempest
elementals-unbound-tempest.how_to_play: Buff the shop with Nomi or Air Revenant, whichever you find first. Use Brann + Tavern Tempest + Kelp Keeper for economy and elemental generation. Flaming Enforcer stabilizes midgame; Unbound Tempest caps scaling. Cycle premium elementals (Sellemental, Refreshing Anomaly).
